scripts.generate:ios: if command -v ubrn >/dev/null 2>&1; then ubrn build ios --and-generate --config ubrn.config.yaml && sed -i '' 's#"apps/[^"]*mobile/cpp/generated/inward_core.hpp"#"generated/inward_core.hpp"#' apps/mobile/cpp/swa-mobile.cpp; else echo 'ubrn CLI not found. Skipping native binding generation and using existing bindings or JS fallback.'; fi
scripts.generate:android: if command -v ubrn >/dev/null 2>&1; then ubrn build android --and-generate --config ubrn.config.yaml && sed -i '' 's#"apps/[^"]*mobile/cpp/generated/inward_core.hpp"#"generated/inward_core.hpp"#' apps/mobile/cpp/swa-mobile.cpp; else echo 'ubrn CLI not found. Skipping native binding generation and using existing bindings or JS fallback.'; fi
scripts.generate: npm run generate:android && npm run generate:ios
scripts.prebuild: npm run generate && npm run --workspace inward-journey prebuild
scripts.ios: npm run generate:ios && npm run --workspace inward-journey ios
scripts.android: npm run generate:android && npm run --workspace inward-journey android
scripts.test:all: npm run test:rust && npm run test:rust:ml
